title: AlzheimerODE: A Knowledge-Guided Generative Model for Alzheimer's Disease Progression
summary: A knowledge-guided generative framework that models Alzheimer's disease progression as a continuous-time dynamical process with structured pathological kinetics and survival-conditioned modulation. Its baselines directory vendors the sdv-dev CTGAN package (including its CTGAN/TVAE synthesizers) and calls sdmetrics's QualityReport, DiagnosticReport and LogisticDetection to evaluate generated data quality against real patient data.
evidence: alzheimer_ode/baselines/tvae/train_sample_tvae.py:7 'from CTGAN.ctgan import TVAESynthesizer'; eval_density.py:8 imports sdmetrics QualityReport/DiagnosticReport
needs: CTGAN copy under baselines/tvae/CTGAN is the sdv-dev CTGAN source (setup.py url points to sdv-dev/CTGAN); rdt is only pulled in transitively via that vendored package, not called directly by AlzheimerODE code.
